title: FanzyZones - Overlay activates when clicking Steam Title Bar
author: h3x1e
summary: A single click on Steam's custom title bar briefly triggers the FancyZones overlay even though the configured activation requires a sustained title-bar hold.
next_action: Reproduce on current stable with Steam and compare custom-title-bar pointer messages against a standard Win32 title bar.

confidence.rationale: The visible symptom and interaction are precise, though the current message sequence is unverified.

judgment.rationale: The report supplies a short deterministic interaction and a recording; the remaining question is whether current Steam window messages still take the drag state through FancyZones activation.
evidence: The body gives a three-step Steam reproduction and a video attachment.
The overlay appears only briefly on a click without window movement.
The expected configured behavior is activation after holding the title bar for two seconds.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current stable with Steam and compare custom-title-bar pointer messages against a standard Win32 title bar.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current behavior needs a focused message-level reproduction before selecting a drag-state guard.

issue_context.summary: A single click on Steam's custom title bar briefly triggers the FancyZones overlay even though the configured activation requires a sustained title-bar hold.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.89.0.
Steam uses a nonstandard title bar surface.
inferences: Steam may emit a transient move/drag sequence that starts and immediately cancels FancyZones activation.
issue_context.analysis: A side-by-side message trace is the cheapest way to determine whether the defect belongs to FancyZones drag-state filtering or Steam-specific window behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report, recording reference, labels, and latest confirmation.
Found no linked fix, assignee, or duplicate in the live issue metadata.

actions.label: Reproduce Steam title-bar overlay flash
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare click and hold activation on Steam and a standard window
setup: Open Steam and a standard Explorer or Notepad window.
steps: Single-click Steam's title bar without moving the pointer and record whether the overlay flashes.
Click and hold the same location for two seconds and confirm normal overlay activation.
Repeat both actions on the standard window.
Capture FancyZones logs around the two Steam interactions.
reproduce.expected_result: A click without drag or hold never shows the overlay; the configured sustained hold still activates it.
